name: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow moat: embeddedness in client estates (running a payer's claims platform or a bank's core operations, plus proprietary TriZetto healthcare software) creates real switching costs, and scale/global India delivery plus vertical expertise sustain ~16% operating margins and OE positive 5 of 5 years. Capped at 5 because most work is labour services competitors (Accenture, TCS, Infosys, Wipro) can replicate, many contracts are short-term/terminable on short notice, there is no owned consumer/product lock-in beyond pockets like TriZetto, returns have been pressured, and AI automation threatens the headcount-arbitrage model itself.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 4.94 vs 3-yr median 3.64 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Solid, cash-generative IT-services franchise, moat 5/10 — but slow guided growth (4.0-5.5% CC for 2026) does not clear 15% at $62.85 (weighted IRR 11.43%, IV@15% $44.38); clears 15% only at or below $44.38, ~$35 with a margin of safety.
moat_for: Embeddedness in client estates — institutional knowledge of a payer's claims platform or a bank's core operations is expensive to rebuild
Proprietary TriZetto healthcare software inside client revenue cycles, not just services
Scale and global delivery — predominantly India-based workforce billed at Western rates, vertical expertise in Financial Services and Health Sciences
Proven cash generation through a cycle — OE positive 5 of last 5 FY, ~16% operating margin, net cash on the FY2025 balance sheet
moat_against: Labour-arbitrage model is replicable — Accenture, TCS, Infosys and Wipro match scale and delivery; no structural cost moat
Weak contractual lock-in — many contracts are short-term and terminable on short notice; visibility comes from bookings, not lock-in
AI automation threat — AI-led productivity deflates the headcount pyramid the model is built on; Project Leap restructuring is the admission
Wage inflation, attrition (13.0% voluntary Tech Services TTM at Q2 2026) and pricing pressure cap pricing power
